verdict.rationale: The Claude Agent SDK is itself a documented public API/SDK (Python and TypeScript) with extensive first-party docs covering programmatic access, tools, hooks, sessions, permissions, streaming, and hosting, directly enabling AI-native users to drive it programmatically. Community evidence corroborates real-world programmatic usage (e.g., headless workflows via claude -p) though it also raises usage-policy friction unrelated to API documentation quality itself. Missing for 10: independent third-party API completeness audits or versioned changelog stability evidence.
